sys_di_key.description:
Analyze the ENTIRE uploaded report/document and identify all legal/court cases.
Extract: - Court Name - Court Type - Case Status - Case Amount (if available)
Normalize statuses: Open statuses: - Open - Pending - Ongoing - Under Hearing - Active
Closed statuses: - Disposed - Closed - Settled - Withdrawn - Dismissed
---------------------------------------------------- SEVERITY RULES ----------------------------------------------------
1. NCLT + Open/Pending Severity = "Major"
2. DRT or District Court + Open/Pending Severity = "Medium"
3. Local Court / Civil Court / Consumer Court / Labour Court / Others + Open/Pending Severity = "Minor"
4. Any Disposed/Closed/Settled/Dismissed case Severity = "Nil"
---------------------------------------------------- FINAL OUTPUT RULES ----------------------------------------------------
1. If no cases found OR all cases are Nil: Final Output = "No Cases"
2. If only Minor severity cases exist: Final Output = "Minor Civil"
3. If Medium severity cases exist and active cases are between 1-2: Final Output = "1-2 Active"
4. If any Major severity case exists OR more than 2 active cases exist OR fraud/criminal keywords found: Final Output = "Multiple/Fraud"
Return ONLY one final value from: - No Cases - Minor Civil - 1-2 Active - Multiple/Fraud
sys_di_key.name: Court Cases
